Provides a resource to create a CBS storage.

> **NOTE:** When creating an encrypted disk, if `kmsKeyId` is not entered, the product side will generate a key by default.

> **NOTE:** When using CBS encrypted disk, it is necessary to add `CVM_QcsRole` role and `QcloudKMSAccessForCVMRole` strategy to the account.

## Example Usage

* Create:
  - [CreateDisks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/16312)
  - [DescribeDisks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/16315)
  - [ModifyDiskBackupQuota](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/50786)
* Read:
  - [DescribeDisks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/16315)
  - [DescribeResourceTagsByResourceIds](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/651/33022)
* Update:
  - [ApplySnapshot](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/15643)
  - [DescribeDisks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/16315)
  - [ModifyDiskAttributes](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/15659)
  - [ModifyDiskBackupQuota](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/50786)

  - [ModifyDisksChargeType](https://www.tencentcloud.com/search/?wd=ModifyDisksChargeType&type=document&lang=en)
  - [ModifyDisksRenewFlag](https://www.tencentcloud.com/search/?wd=ModifyDisksRenewFlag&type=document&lang=en)
  - [ModifyResourceTags](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/651/33012)
  - [ResizeDisk](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/16310)
* Delete:

  - [TerminateDisks](https://www.tencentcloud.com/document/api/362/16321)

This parameter maps to <code>AutoMountConfiguration.InstanceId</code> of the <code>CreateDisks</code> API. Note: 1. encrypted disks do not support auto-mounting, so this parameter cannot be used together with <code>encrypt</code>. 2.Cannot be used simultaneously with <code>tencentcloud.Cbs.StorageSetAttachment</code>. 3.Modification is not supported. The current field only supports binding to an instance when creating a CBS instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

## Import



CBS storage can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cbs/storage:Storage example disk-41s6jwy4
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
